title: 第13章 交付丹药第14章 我就是百草轩的炼丹师
content_zh:
;;
黑虎帮总坛，烛火摇曳。
大厅正中的虎皮交椅上，端坐着一位魁梧如山的大汉。
他裸露的臂膀上盘踞着狰狞的虎头刺青，正是黑虎帮帮主楚天霸。
林远山坐在下首，慢条斯理地品着茶，冷笑道：
“楚兄，明日便是百草轩交付丹药的最后期限。”
“林义失踪三月，那百草轩如今只剩一个黄毛丫头和一个被采补过的废物，连一个像样的炼丹师都没有，绝无可能炼出三百瓶壮血丹和两百瓶金疮散！”
楚天霸哈哈一笑：“林家主放心！他百草轩若是交不出丹药，胆敢违约，到时候，可就别怪我黑虎帮按规矩办事了！”
“兄弟们最近正好手头紧，他那百草轩的铺面、里面的东西，正好拿来抵债。”
林远山满意一笑：“楚兄明白人。待到百草轩违约，你们便可名正言顺地发难。”
“明日我会多带些天风城有头有脸的人物一同前往，大庭广众之下，他们违约在先，我们占尽道理。”
“便是林义日后安全归来，也没理由找我们麻烦。”
虽然林义消失三个月，但是林远山对林义很是充满忌惮，此人实力强悍，即便是他突破真罡多年，也不是对手。
这样做，没彻底撕破脸面，也是为了以防万一。
他顿了顿，眼中闪过一丝贪婪：
“事成之后，我林家只要林义可能留下的那本《九玄丹经》。”
“至于其余，甚至整个百草轩资产，尽数归你黑虎帮所有！”
“林清萱不过一个黄毛丫头，周尘更是被玉女宫采补过的废物，拿什么跟我们斗？”
楚天霸眼中精光一闪，显然对这个分配很是心动。
百草轩的位置和产业，价值不菲。

他大手一拍桌子：“好！就依林家主所言！明日，我会多带些弟兄，给你壮声势！”
楚天霸哈哈大笑，端起酒碗一饮而尽：
“好！就这么办！明日辰时，我亲自带人去百草轩收账！倒要看看那两个小崽子，还能翻出什么浪来！”
林远山举起酒杯，阴冷一笑：“楚兄，合作愉快。”
“要怪，就怪林清萱和周尘那两小崽子，我本给了他们机会，是他们自己非要叛出林家，自寻死路！这就怪不得林某心狠手辣了！”
……
……
百草轩。
周尘长舒一口气，看着眼前众多数百个玉瓶，满意一笑。
“成了，黑虎帮需要的所有丹药，全部炼制完毕。”
在阴阳塔内，他终于将订单所需的壮血丹和金疮散尽数炼成。
“炼这么多丹药，对我提升炼丹经验也有不少帮助。”
如此大批量的炼制，虽然枯燥，却也让他的控火手法和炼丹熟练度再次提升，对《九玄丹经》的理解也更深了一层。
他将所有玉瓶分门别类地收好，心念一动，离开了阴阳塔，回到了百草轩的炼丹房内。
明天就是交付丹药的日子，此时外界天色已晚，不过周尘并没有休息。
“一切准备妥当，等明天黑虎帮的事情解决了，是该好好想想怎么找林婉儿那个臭婊子报仇了！”
周尘眼中寒光一闪，杀意涌动。
他没有浪费时间，再次心念沉入，进入阴阳塔中，盘膝而坐，开始运转《九劫纯阳经》，吸收炼化体内残留的、来自吕玉清的精纯阴元，巩固自身修为。
一夜无话。
当周尘再次睁开眼时，外界已是清晨。他缓缓吐出一口浊气，气息悠长而沉凝。

经过一夜的苦修，他不仅彻底稳固了采补吕玉清得来的力量，更是将修为彻底稳固在了凝元境三重巅峰！
轰！

The candlelight flickered in the Black Tiger Gang's main altar.
Sitting on the tiger-skin chair in the middle of the hall was a burly man as tall as a mountain.
There is a ferocious tiger head tattoo on his bare arm. It is none other than Chu Tianba, the leader of the Black Tiger Gang.
Lin Yuanshan sat at the bottom, sipping tea slowly and sneered:
"Brother Chu, tomorrow is the deadline for Baicao Xuan to deliver the elixir."
"Lin Yi has been missing for three months. Now there is only a yellow-haired girl and a piece of waste left in Baicaoxuan. There is not even a decent alchemist. It is absolutely impossible to refine three hundred bottles of blood-strengthening pills and two hundred bottles of golden sore powder!"
Chu Tianba laughed loudly: "Don't worry, Master Lin! If Baicao Xuan cannot hand over the elixir and dares to break the contract, then don't blame me, the Black Tiger Gang, for acting according to the rules!"
"Brothers are short of money recently. His Baicaoxuan shop and the contents inside can be used to pay off debts."
Lin Yuanshan smiled with satisfaction: "Brother Chu understands people. When Baicao Xuan breaks the contract, you can justifiably raise the issue."
"Tomorrow I will bring more prominent people from Tianfeng City with me. In public, they broke the contract first, and we take full advantage of it."
"Even if Lin Yi returns safely in the future, there will be no reason to cause trouble for us."
Although Lin Yi disappeared for three months, Lin Yuanshan was very afraid of Lin Yi. This man was so powerful that even if he had broken through Zhen Gang for many years, he was still no match.
I did this without completely breaking my face, but also just in case.
He paused, a trace of greed flashed in his eyes:
"After the matter is completed, my Lin family only wants the "Nine Mysterious Alchemy Sutra" that Lin Yi may have left behind."
"As for the rest, even the entire Baicaoxuan assets, all belong to your Black Tiger Gang!"
"Lin Qingxuan is nothing more than a yellow-haired girl, and Zhou Chen is a waste that has been picked up by the Jade Lady Palace. How can he fight with us?"
Chu Tianba's eyes flashed, and he was obviously very excited about this assignment.
Baicaoxuan's location and property are valuable.
He slapped the table with his big hand: "Okay! Just as the head of the Lin family said! Tomorrow, I will bring more brothers to give you more momentum!"
Chu Tianba laughed loudly, picked up the wine bowl and drank it all in one gulp:
"Okay! Let's do it! Tomorrow at midnight, I will personally take people to Baicao Pavilion to collect the bill! I want to see what those two brats can do!"
Lin Yuanshan raised his wine glass and smiled coldly: "Brother Chu, happy cooperation."
"If you want to blame, blame those two brats Lin Qingxuan and Zhou Chen. I gave them a chance, but they insisted on betraying the Lin family and seeking death! No wonder Lin is so cruel!"
…
…
Baicaoxuan.
Zhou Chen breathed a long sigh of relief, looked at the hundreds of jade bottles in front of him, and smiled with satisfaction.
"It's done, all the elixirs needed by the Black Tiger Gang have been refined."
In the Yin-Yang Tower, he finally refined all the blood-strengthening pills and golden sore powder required for the order.
"Refining so many elixirs will also help me a lot to improve my experience in elixir refining."
Although such large-scale refining was boring, it also improved his fire control skills and alchemy proficiency again, and also deepened his understanding of the "Nine Mysterious Alchemy Sutra".
He put away all the jade bottles in categories, and with a thought, left the Yin-Yang Tower and returned to the alchemy room of Baicao Xuan.
Tomorrow was the day to deliver the elixir. It was already getting late outside, but Zhou Chen did not rest.
"Everything is ready. When the Black Tiger Gang's matter is resolved tomorrow, it's time to think about how to take revenge on that stinky bitch Lin Wan'er!"
A cold light flashed in Zhou Chen's eyes, and murderous intent surged.
He wasted no time, and once again entered the Yin-Yang Tower, sat cross-legged, and began to run the "Nine Tribulations Pure Yang Sutra" to absorb and refine the remaining pure Yin Yuan from Lu Yuqing in his body to consolidate his own cultivation.
A night of silence.
When Zhou Chen opened his eyes again, it was already early morning outside. He slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, his breath long and concentrated.
After a night of hard work,Not only did he completely stabilize the power gained from supplementing Lu Yuqing, but he also completely stabilized his cultivation at the third level peak of the Condensing Yuan Realm!
boom!
